newsitem.title: GERMANY: Key German Ifo business index nudges higher.
newsitem.headline: Key German Ifo business index nudges higher.

text.p: German business confidence nudged slightly higher in February, the closely-watched Ifo business climate index showed on Wednesday.

The west German Ifo index stood at 93.6 in February after 93.3 in January and business expectations rose to 104 from 103.6. However in eastern Germany, the business climate index dropped to 104.1 from 106.5 last month.
"In general this can be taken as a good sign there will be a pick-up in the economy in a moderate way," said Commerzbank economist Ann Katrin Jaenke.
The news had a mildy supporting effect on German share and bond markets, which viewed the news as indicating acceptable levels of growth. Forecasts for the index had averaged at around 93.5 to 93.8.

Ifo also released its data on a new basis, balancing out positive and negative views from companies in west and east Germany to give data that it believes better reflect business confidence after unification.

That data, which reflect a change in business confidence from month-ago numbers rather than giving an index value compared with the base year of 1991, gave a figure of minus 7.9 for western Germany versus minus 8.4 in January and minus 12.8 for east Germany compared with minus 8.4.
East and west index figures had drifted apart after the eastern post-unification upswing and the western states' recession.
